title: Shifted Hom from integral constructible complexes preserves the localization unit telescope
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite normed extension, and let $X$ have Noetherian underlying topological space. Use the actual integral coefficient category and scalar extension $L$ of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients], and let $K,B$ be integral bounded constructible objects. Let $U$ be restriction of scalars, and let $t_B$ be the scalar localization unit cocone of [def-weil-pbc-integral-localization-telescope]: its stages are $B$, its transitions are $\ell\operatorname{id}_B$, its vertex is $ULB$, and its $n$th leg is the adjunction unit followed by $U$ of inverse multiplication by $\ell^n$. For every $q\in\mathbf Z$, the canonical map induced by these legs is an isomorphism of abelian groups
$$\varinjlim_{n\in\mathbf N}\operatorname{Hom}(K,B[q])\ \longrightarrow\ \operatorname{Hom}(K,(ULB)[q]).$$
Equivalently, this cocone has the shifted Hom-colimit property of [def-weil-pbc-hom-colimit-property]. The same assertion holds after reindexing by $\operatorname{ULift}\mathbf N$.
